meta.title: Co-invest in Turin student housing | Jungle Rent
meta.description: Jungle Rent opens portfolio participation to a limited number of private investors via Italian Participating Financial Instruments (SFP). Request the information memorandum.

hero.h1: Co-invest in Turin student housing, with someone who shows their face.
hero.subhead: Jungle Rent is a Turin-based innovative startup that buys, renovates and manages apartments for university students. We open portfolio participation to a limited number of private investors through Participating Financial Instruments (SFP, Italian Civil Code art. 2346).
hero.ctaNote: Subscription does not happen online. The first step is an information request: receive the memorandum, evaluate it calmly, decide afterwards.

founder.title: A letter from the founder
paragraphs: I'm Lorenzo, founder of Jungle Rent. I built this company with a simple idea: Turin has 90,000 university students and a real estate market that is still accessible. Buying well, renovating well, and managing well, you can build solid cash flows in a historically defensive asset class.

I open participation to a small group of private investors for a practical reason: accelerate portfolio construction without diluting share capital excessively. I do this with an instrument (SFP) that aligns incentives — I take 10% of profits, you take 90%, after servicing.

This page gives you the perimeter. The real numbers, the structure, the models, the contracts — all that is in the memorandum. I send it only after a brief introductory call, because I want to make sure the opportunity and your expectations are compatible.
If you are interested, fill out the form at the bottom of the page. I'll respond personally within 48 hours.

thesis.title: Why Turin, why now, why us

market.title: Underserved market
market.body: 90,000 university students, 7 institutions (Politecnico, UniTo, ESCP, IED, IAAD, SAA, IUSTO). Housing demand chronically exceeds regular supply. Rents range from €350 to €700 per single room depending on the area.

asset.title: Defensive asset class at accessible prices
asset.body: Two-room apartments in target areas (Lingotto, Aurora, Cenisia, San Salvario, Vanchiglia) trade today between €45,000 and €130,000. Gross student-rental yields above 10% in the most efficient areas, stabilized by inelastic demand.

model.title: Hybrid model
model.body: 10 student months (September–June) + summer tourist season (July–August) on Airbnb and Booking. The mix optimizes occupancy and increases net yield versus a student-only strategy.

innovativa.title: What changes because we are an innovative startup

fg.title: Privileged bank financing
fg.body: We access the SME Guarantee Fund with free 80% coverage for innovative startups. This lets us obtain unsecured loans without mortgaging the property, keeping it free for future recapitalizations or disposals.

tax.title: Tax incentive for investors
tax.body: Private investors who subscribe to SFP in an innovative startup may benefit from an IRPEF deduction up to 65% of the invested amount (de minimis regime, EU Reg. 2831/2023). The incentive is subject to individual limits and conditions, to be verified with your tax advisor. Details in the memorandum. Non-Italian tax residents may not benefit from the 65% IRPEF deduction. Tax treatment applicable to foreign investors depends on individual residence and should be assessed with a local tax advisor.

transparency.title: Mandatory transparency
transparency.body: As an innovative startup we are required to publish updated company data every six months on the special section of the Business Register, and we keep a publicly consultable chamber registration. Every investor can independently verify the company's status.

process.title: From first contact to subscription

steps.title: Request the memorandum
steps.body: Fill out the form at the bottom of the page.

steps.title: Introductory call (30 minutes)
steps.body: I personally call you back within 48 hours to understand your horizon, your experience, your questions.

steps.title: Receive the materials
steps.body: Information memorandum, SFP regulation, business plan, Excel financial model, corporate body minutes.

steps.title: Time to evaluate
steps.body: No pressure. You can involve your accountant, lawyer, or trusted advisor.

steps.title: Signature
steps.body: If you decide to proceed, the subscription deed is signed in person before the appointed notary, simultaneously with the payment.

process.callout: No step is automated. Every investor who joins Jungle Rent does so after speaking with Lorenzo directly.

tax.title: Tax treatment of the investment
tax.content: Investments in SFP of innovative startups may benefit from the 65% IRPEF deduction pursuant to art. 29-bis DL 179/2012, in the de minimis regime introduced by EU Reg. 2831/2023. The legislation is in force until 04/12/2028, subject to extensions.
tax.caveat: The actual applicability and measure of the deduction depends on individual investor limits, on the residual de minimis allowance of the company, and on compliance with a series of conditions provided by the regulations. No information on this page constitutes tax advice. Before any decision, consult your trusted accountant or ask our team to put you in touch with the tax firm assisting Jungle Rent. Non-Italian tax residents may not benefit from the 65% IRPEF deduction.

items.title: Illiquidity
items.body: The tax lock-up is 3 years. There is no organized secondary market. SFPs are privately transferable, but finding a buyer is your responsibility.

items.title: Execution risk
items.body: At the time of publication of this page, Jungle Rent does not yet own properties. The entire business plan relies on the ability to close the first acquisition in time for academic year 2026/2027, and on the ability to repeat it efficiently.

items.title: Real estate market risk
items.body: Significant changes in the Turin market (prices, student demand, short-term rental regulation) may impact portfolio returns.

items.title: Dilution risk
items.body: Future capital rounds could dilute your relative share, although SFPs have proportionally protected economic rights.

items.title: No guaranteed returns
items.body: Expected returns presented in the business plan are projections. Actual performance will depend on operational execution and market conditions. A partial or total loss of invested capital is reasonably possible.

items.q: What is a Participating Financial Instrument (SFP)?
items.a: It is an instrument provided for by art. 2346 of the Italian Civil Code that grants economic rights (share of profits, liquidation) without administrative rights (voting in shareholder meetings). It is comparable to a non-voting preferred share.
The indicative range is €5,000–€20,000 per investor. Smaller or larger tickets are evaluated case by case based on round and investor profile.

items.q: Can I recover capital before 3 years?
items.a: The 3-year lock-up is a tax requirement (to keep the IRPEF deduction). Technically you can transfer the instrument to another investor, but you would lose the tax incentive and would need to find a buyer independently.
The SFP regulation provides for a 90% investors / 10% Jungle Rent split after the servicing fee, according to a waterfall detailed in the memorandum. Distribution is bi-monthly.

items.q: Is Jungle Rent really an innovative startup or is it self-declared?
items.a: Registration in the special section of the Business Register took place on 04/12/2025 and is independently verifiable on startup.registroimprese.it with VAT 13333450016.

items.q: Can I see the business plan and financial model?
items.a: Yes, after the qualification call. They are complete documents (2025 business plan, multi-sheet Excel model with sensitivity analysis, 5-year projections).
Tax assistance from the Starola Cantino Bono firm in Turin. Annual financial statements are public on the chamber registration.

items.q: What happens if Jungle Rent fails to close the first acquisition by September 2026?
items.a: Capital raised is held in the corporate account awaiting the next market window, or returned to investors upon their request, net of documented costs. This clause is written in the SFP regulation.

disclaimer.p1: The information on this page is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a public offering of financial products under art. 94 of Italian Legislative Decree 58/1998 (TUF — Italian Consolidated Financial Act), nor an investment solicitation, nor financial, tax or legal advice.
disclaimer.p2: The Participating Financial Instruments described are not available for online subscription. Any subscription occurs exclusively via private placement, reserved to a restricted number of individually qualified investors, after delivery of the complete information memorandum and SFP regulation, in compliance with the exemptions provided by art. 100 TUF.
disclaimer.p3: Returns illustrated in informational materials are projections based on model assumptions. Actual performance depends on portfolio performance and is in no way guaranteed. Investment carries risks, including illiquidity risk, real estate market risk, operational execution risk, dilution risk, and the possibility of total loss of invested capital.
disclaimer.p4: The tax treatment described is subject to individual conditions, regulatory limits and possible legislative changes. Before any investment decision, the investor must consult their own independent tax and financial advisor.
